summary: Cleopatra Enterprise is the Leading Project Cost Management Software and Consultancy Company, founded in 1996. Type: private company. About 138 employees (LinkedIn page). Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 6 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06
LinkedIn page (existing data, collected via Apify; LinkedIn terms forbid scraping)

insights.one_liner: Zwijndrecht software and consultancy firm for project cost and turnaround management; English-language entry roles, some mentioning visa support.

culture.text: About 138 people, founded in 1996 by cost engineers and project-controls experts; offices include Houston and Dubai.
Staff often studied mechanical or chemical engineering at TU Delft or Dutch universities of applied sciences.
Runs its own certified Academy and lists learning and growth, innovation and collaboration as core values.

open.text: All 6 jobs here are open to non-Dutch speakers; 17% mention visa support and 67% show pay.
Not found as an IND recognised sponsor.

growth.text: Says it has helped over 500 companies in 75 countries manage complex projects and turnarounds.

worth_knowing.text: Most open roles are entry-level (4 of 6) and based in Zwijndrecht, near Rotterdam.
